blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte is in constant communication with her lawyers to avoid potentially being cited for contempt for violating the sub judice rule in her impeachment trial, defense panel spokesperson Michael Poa said on Monday. Poa made the pronouncement after two members of the House prosecution panel were issued show-cause orders by the Senate impeachment court for supposedly violating the sub judice rule.
